title: Spider bite leads Fox to one of the girls

tellings.quote: incident." He goes, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls."

plain: The documentary filmmaker James Fox says that in 2012, in Varginha, Brazil, a town known for a case in which the army is said to have captured a live alien, a spider bite led him to a man who told him, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls," meaning one of the young women who were witnesses in the case. Fox tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and he presents it as the chance that put him in touch with a witness.
